From: Tony Liao <tony.liao@arcadiafoods.com>

Date: 2026-05-21T09:16:00-07:00
Subject: Unable to accept Ariba activation — clicking 'Activate' loops

Hi Dylan,

We're trying to onboard Arcadia Foods as a supplier in Ariba but when our procurement contact clicks the activation link in the invite the browser immediately bounces through a 302 chain and ends up back at the Ariba landing page. We tried Chrome and Edge, incognito mode, and it still loops. Screenshot attached (ariba_activate_302_screenshot.png).

Our corporate proxy team told us they see Host header rewriting for upstream TLS inspection that could be changing the RelayState. They asked if the invite URL contains any tracking params that might be stripped.

This is blocking our PO flow — can you confirm whether the invite can be accepted manually or if there's a workaround?

Thanks,
Tony Liao
IT Ops 
Arcadia Foods

Subject: Re: Unable to accept Ariba activation — clicking 'Activate' loops

Tony — thanks for the screenshot and the heads up. Sorry you're blocked. A couple quick asks while we triage:

- Can you attach a full SAML trace (IdP->SP exchange) from your IdP admin? If they can export the POST/Redirect payload that would help (we often see RelayState trimmed by proxies).
- Try one more test: open the activation URL in an incognito window on a device off the corp VPN (personal hotspot) — that'll confirm whether the corporate proxy is the culprit.

Monica / Ben — looping you in to check whether a manual create on Ariba (temporary account + one-time password) is safe here and what fields we need from Arcadia to finish onboarding.

Tony — we'll keep you posted. If this is RelayState being rewritten we can either: 1) request an IdP metadata update to include a persistent NameID/subject, or 2) create the vendor record manually and send credentials so the PO flow is unblocked while we fix SSO.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Procurement Onboarding
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-21T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SAML trace from Arcadia (preliminary)

Forwarding the SAML trace Tony just sent (saml_trace_arcadia.xml). Quick read shows the IdP is returning a blank NameID in the assertion and RelayState on the SP side looks truncated in the POST payload (proxy likely cutting after the first '=').

Ben — can you confirm whether Ariba tolerates a NameID==null for the initial activation? If not, we need Arcadia's IdP to include a persistent NameID or change the binding to use an encrypted NameID.

If Ariba won't accept the assertion we'll fall back to manual vendor creation. I can handle the paperwork and escalate to Marissa if we need an SLA exception for temporary credentials.

Preliminary timeline: if Arcadia's IdP can push updated metadata today we can reissue the invite and retry within our next maintenance window (tomorrow 10–11am PT).

— Monica
Solutions Engineer, Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I pushed this to our IdP team (idp-admin@arcadiafoods.com). They confirmed the proxy strips long query strings for security and can change the policy, but will need a change window to update outbound rewriting rules. I've attached a sanitized HTTP trace and the screenshot again for reference.

Can you confirm the manual vendor-create flow and what information you need from us to create the account in Ariba so we can get POs moving? If there's a short-term manual onboarding we can accept that while our IdP updates rules.

Estimate from IdP team: they can do the rewrite whitelist in ~24 hours if we schedule it.

Regards,
Tony

Tony — thanks for the update and for coordinating with your IdP team.

Short-term workaround (I will execute):
- We will manually create the Arcadia supplier record in Ariba and send a one-time activation email (one-time password) to your procurement contact so POs can be acknowledged.
- Required fields for the manual create: legal entity name, W-9 / VAT ID (if applicable), remit-to address, primary procurement contact name and email, and bank remittance instructions if you want PO-to-invoice automation. Please drop those in a reply or via the secure form link below.

Planned permanent fix:
- Once your IdP adjusts the proxy whitelist we will reissue the Ariba invite and validate the SAML assertion. Monica will run the validation during the maintenance window tomorrow (2026-05-24 10:00–11:00 PT).

I've opened JIRA PROC-4837 to track both the manual create and the IdP metadata change. I'll also file an SLA exception for issuing temporary credentials — copy of change request here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4837

Tony — if you confirm the required fields I will proceed with manual creation now and email credentials securely.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
